versions.heading: Signatures of Judicial Officers and Court Officials
versions.text:
(a) Signature of judicial officer. Documents requiring a judge's or commissioner's signature may be signed by an original signature, stamped signature, or an electronic graphic representation of a signature.

(b) Signature of clerk. Documents requiring a clerk's signature may be signed by an original signature, stamped signature, an electronic graphic representation of a signature, or /s/ John or Jane Clerk.
(c) Signature of court reporter and transcriber. Documents requiring a court reporter's or transcriber's signature may be signed by an original signature, stamped signature, an electronic graphic representation of a signature, or /s/ John or Jane Person.
